name: reference-stand-in
note: A reference stand-in, not Speedy's rebate engine. It implements the two program kinds the spec names and nothing else: no tiers, minimums, accruals or proration. Every amount it produces is stored with this name and version.

programKinds.basis: Cases: the line qty for a case-priced line, qty / pack size for an each-priced one.

programOutcomes.sentence: The calculation did not finish for this program. Start it again.
No lines on this file are for this program's manufacturer. Check the brand column's mapping, or the manufacturer list.
This program was not in effect during any period on this file. Check its effective dates.

rounding.rule: One multiplication and one rounding per line, over the unquantised rate and basis. Period totals are the sum of per-line amounts, never a rounding of an aggregate basis.

skippedReasons.sentence: A catch-weight item with no weight on the line, so there are no pounds to pay on. Add the shipped weight for this line.
Priced by the each with no pack size, so the case count cannot be worked out. Add the pack size for this item.
